detail.question: Quels sont les dix produits les plus vendus, en nombre d'articles ?

    COUNT(*) AS nombre_articles_vendus

detail.question: Quelles sont les dix categories de produits qui rapportent le plus, en euros ?
detail.sql_produit:
SELECT
    p.product_category_name AS categorie_produit,
    SUM(oi.price) AS chiffre_affaires
FROM entrepot."order_items" oi
JOIN entrepot."products" p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN entrepot."orders" o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
  AND p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.product_category_name
ORDER BY chiffre_affaires DESC
LIMIT 10

detail.question: Les commentaires des clients mecontents sont-ils plus longs que ceux des clients satisfaits ?
detail.sql_produit:
WITH reviews_classified AS (
    SELECT 
        review_score,
        review_comment_message,
        CASE 
            WHEN review_score <= 2 THEN 'Mécontent'
            WHEN review_score >= 4 THEN 'Satisfait'
            ELSE 'Neutre'
        END AS satisfaction_level,
        LENGTH(review_comment_message) AS comment_length
    FROM entrepot."order_reviews"
    WHERE review_comment_message IS NOT NULL 
      AND review_comment_message != ''
)
SELECT 
    satisfaction_level,
    COUNT(*) AS nombre_commentaires,
    ROUND(AVG(comment_length), 2) AS longueur_moyenne_caracteres,
    ROUND(MIN(comment_length), 2) AS longueur_min,
    ROUND(MAX(comment_length), 2) AS longueur_max
FROM reviews_classified
WHERE satisfaction_level IN ('Mécontent', 'Satisfait')
GROUP BY satisfaction_level
ORDER BY satisfaction_level
LIMIT 1000

detail.question: Quel est le taux de commandes livrees ?

detail.question: Quel pourcentage de commandes arrive en retard par rapport a la date estimee ?
detail.sql_produit:
SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS total_commandes_livrees,
    SUM(CASE WHEN TRY_CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP) > TRY_CAST(o.order_estimated_delivery_date AS TIMESTAMP) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS commandes_en_retard,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN TRY_CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP) > TRY_CAST(o.order_estimated_delivery_date AS TIMESTAMP) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
        2
    ) AS pourcentage_retard
FROM entrepot."orders" o
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
  AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
  AND o.order_estimated_delivery_date IS NOT NULL
LIMIT 1000;

detail.question: Le delai de livraison depend-il de l'etat du client ?
detail.sql_produit:
SELECT
    c.customer_state AS etat_client,
    COUNT(*) AS nombre_commandes,
    AVG(DATE_DIFF('day', TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP), TRY_CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP))) AS delai_moyen_jours
FROM entrepot."orders" o
JOIN entrepot."customers" c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
  AND TRY_CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
  AND TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.customer_state
ORDER BY delai_moyen_jours DESC
LIMIT 1000

detail.question: Quelle est la repartition des clients entre Sao Paulo et le reste du pays ?
detail.sql_produit:
SELECT 
    region,
    nombre_clients,
    ROUND(100.0 * nombre_clients / SUM(nombre_clients) OVER(), 2) AS pourcentage
FROM (
    SELECT 
        CASE 
            WHEN customer_state = 'SP' THEN 'São Paulo'
            ELSE 'Reste du pays'
        END AS region,
        COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) AS nombre_clients
    FROM entrepot."customers"
    GROUP BY 
        CASE 
            WHEN customer_state = 'SP' THEN 'São Paulo'
            ELSE 'Reste du pays'
        END
)
ORDER BY nombre_clients DESC
LIMIT 1000

detail.question: La note moyenne s'est-elle amelioree entre 2017 et 2018 ?
detail.sql_produit:
SELECT 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TRY_CAST(review_creation_date AS TIMESTAMP)) AS annee,
    ROUND(AVG(review_score), 2) AS note_moyenne
FROM entrepot."order_reviews"
WHERE TRY_CAST(review_creation_date AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TRY_CAST(review_creation_date AS TIMESTAMP)) IN (2017, 2018)
GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TRY_CAST(review_creation_date AS TIMESTAMP))
ORDER BY annee
LIMIT 1000

detail.question: Le delai de livraison moyen a-t-il change entre 2017 et 2018 ?
detail.sql_produit:
SELECT
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) AS annee,
    ROUND(AVG(DATE_DIFF('day', TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP), TRY_CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP))), 2) AS delai_moyen_jours
FROM entrepot."orders" o
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
  AND TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
  AND TRY_CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) IN (2017, 2018)
GROUP BY annee
ORDER BY annee
LIMIT 1000
